description: Validity range of user reheating temperatures for methodology v1 (fixed cosmology, Fuzzy arXiv:2412.12012 scenario (2): w_R = 0). Hard constraints stop the run; warnings are recorded with the results and never change a number.

hard_constraints.T_reh_above_T_eq: T_reh > T_eq (the relic driver's own check; below T_eq the pre/post-reheating split of the v1 methodology does not apply)
hard_constraints.T_reh_inside_gstar_table: T_min(g* table) <= T_reh <= T_max(g* table): no extrapolation of g_rho, g_s (data/standardmodel2018.dat, arXiv:1803.01038)
hard_constraints.H_R_below_H_I_max: 3 H_R < 3 H_I,max (the relic driver's own check; reheating after the end of inflation)

warnings.bbn_warning: T_reh below 5 MeV: at or below the lower bounds of a few MeV on the reheating temperature quoted in the BBN / neutrino-decoupling literature; the computation is performed but the scenario is cosmologically disfavoured
warnings.bbn_edge_note: T_reh below 10 MeV: within a factor of 2 of the BBN-motivated lower bounds; interpret with care

label_rule: labels are used in file names: 1-32 characters from [A-Za-z0-9.+-], unique within a run
